h: h1:Applied AI Engineer building autonomous multi-agent pipelines & modern web applications.
h3:Are you open to full-time remote roles?
text: Applied AI Engineer building autonomous multi-agent pipelines & modern web applications. BS Computer Science Graduate · DLSU-D Based in Cavite, PH · open to remote Applied AI & full-stack roles Built and tested in the open I build AI agents that do real work and the web interfaces around them. My agents can use cloud AI services or run privately on my own computer, and I design the screens people use to work with them. 01 LSFM AI HQ: A team of five AI helpers on Discord that sort my email, tailor my resume for each job and check my code 02 Manas: Ciel: A voice assistant for my desk that answers out loud in Japanese and English, with weather, web search and a live dashboard 03 Memory Core: Saves the mistakes my AI coding tools make and reminds them before the next task Explore Selected Work LSFM AI HQ · 5 Agents Resume (PDF) GitHub FLOW Watch a request run Run Scripted replay A scripted replay of LSFM AI HQ’s request flow. Discord !apply A job link or description posted with !apply in Discord. Sakura splits the job Sakura hands the job to Chaewon, Yunjin and Kazuha. Three specialists, in parallel Resume and cover letter, portfolio picks and a tech pitch, built at the same time. Eunchae's QA check Checked against past lessons before anything reaches me. Approval card Nothing is sent until I approve it. WORK Selected work All 7 AI 3 Web 2 Mobile 2 Gallery Index hanslaureles.vercel.app/case-ciel.html Flagship Manas: Ciel My work was spread across the terminal, Discord, notes and chat tabs, and switching between them by hand broke my focus. Python 3.11 (aiohttp) Groq Whisper Turbo Edge-TTS FFmpeg DSP Vanilla JS/CSS Case study Demo github.com/hanslaureles/lsfm-ai-hq Flagship LSFM AI HQ Busywork across separate tools: digging through promo email, reformatting resumes for every applicant tracker, switching tabs. Python 3.11 Groq + Gemini REST Ollama (optional) Headless Edge/Chrome SQLite Case study Source Agent overview hanslaureles.vercel.app/case-memory.html Flagship Cognitive Memory Core Coding agents forget my corrections between sessions and repeat the same mistakes. Python 3.11 (Stdlib) BM25 Scorer JSONL Case study Demo Aura Coffee & Kitchen A warm coffee-shop store demo. Vanilla HTML CSS JS Case study Lumina Analytics A study and focus dashboard for students. React TypeScript Chart.js Tailwind CSS Case study Vellum A calm, friction-reduced mobile companion for emotional clarity. Figma Auto Layout ProtoPie Case study FinTrack Demystifying personal budgeting with clear visual hierarchies. Figma Auto Layout Variables Case study METHOD How I work 01 Problem & constraint Busywork spread across separate tools. 02 Decisions & their costs What I chose, what I passed over, why, and what it costs. 03 Results you can check Every claim points to public code or a test. 04 What broke & what I'd change A burst of notifications hit the AI service’s usage limit, so I added a backup provider. EXPERIENCE Experience Jun 2024 – Aug 2024 UI/UX & Frontend Engineer Intern ROC.PH Digital Marketing Services Designed and prototyped responsive web and mobile interfaces in Figma. Figma React Tailwind CSS HTML/CSS 2021 – 2025 BS Computer Science De La Salle University–Dasmariñas Distributed Systems, Software Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). Algorithms & Complexities Database Management Systems Object-Oriented Programming PROOF In the open Public LSFM AI HQ tests 434 automated tests, all passing Cognitive Memory Core tests 32 automated tests, all passing Public GitHub activity 268 contributions in the past year As of 21 Oct 2026 FAQ Recruiter FAQ 01Availability 02Time zone 03Teams 04Stack 05Start 01 Are you open to full-time remote roles? Yes: full-time remote Applied AI, agent systems and full-stack roles. OPEN TO FULL-TIME REMOTE ROLES Let's work together. hanslaureles92@gmail.com [COPY] LinkedIn GitHub Resume (PDF)
